summary: The filing is a Form 6-K report of foreign private issuer PicS N.V. (formerly PicPay Holdings Netherlands B.V.), covering the semi-annual period ended June 30, 2026. It includes financial statements, segment results, and subsequent events disclosures. Although there are references to senior units issued in August 2026, these appear to be routine debt or equity instruments rather than a special-situation transaction. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other corporate event is indicated. The filing is a routine periodic report, not a special situation.
